Repository: storybookjs/storybook

Length of output: 616

---

🌐 Web query:

`Danger JS GitHub PR object API danger.github.pr user vs author field`

💡 Result:

In **Danger JS**, the GitHub PR object is `danger.github.pr` (type `GitHubPRDSL`) and the PR submitter/author is exposed as **`user`** (a `GitHubUser`) — there is **no `author` field** on `danger.github.pr`. Use:

- `danger.github.pr.user` (object)
- `danger.github.pr.user.login` (username)

This matches the Danger JS DSL reference, which documents `user: GitHubUser` as “The User who submitted the PR.” [1] and even shows example usage like `danger.github.pr.user.login`. [2]

If you’re looking for a string like “pr author”, that’s a **Danger Ruby** convenience accessor (`github.pr_author`), not the Danger JS PR object shape. [3]

**Sources:**  
[1] ([danger.systems](https://danger.systems/js/reference.html))  
[2] ([danger.systems](https://danger.systems/js/changelog?utm_source=openai))  
[3] ([danger.systems](https://danger.systems/reference.html))

Citations:

- 1: https://danger.systems/js/reference.html
- 2: https://danger.systems/js/changelog?utm_source=openai
- 3: https://danger.systems/reference.html

---

🏁 Script executed:

```shell
rg 'danger\.github\.pr\.' scripts/dangerfile.js -A 2 -B 2
```

Repository: storybookjs/storybook

Length of output: 796

---



</details>

**Use `danger.github.pr.user` here; `pr.author` will break contributor PRs.**

Line 150 uses `danger.github.pr.author`, but Danger's GitHub PR DSL exposes the PR submitter as `danger.github.pr.user`. This makes `author` undefined, causing line 156 to throw a TypeError when accessing `author.login` on any non-`OWNER`/`MEMBER` PR, which aborts the Danger run. The same file uses the correct field elsewhere (see `checkManualTestingSection`).

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-  const author = danger.github.pr.author;
+  const author = danger.github.pr.user;
```
</details>
